title: Days-Late Goodwill Bands, Rental Property Service Contracts Installments
content:
**Goodwill rule.** A Rental Property Service Contracts monthly installment billed after its due date carries a late-billing goodwill rate set by how many days after its due date it is billed:

| Installment billed | Late-billing goodwill |
|---|---|
| more than 20 days after its due date | 0.05 |
| 11 to 20 days after its due date | 0.03 |
| 1 to 10 days after its due date | 0 |

The due date is the period start, which is the day after the last billed installment's period ends; the days are the calendar days from the due date to the billing day.

**How the rate acts.** The credit rates on a late-billed installment are added together and subtracted from one, and the installment is multiplied once by that sum.

## Boundaries

| Days after the due date | Goodwill |
|---|---|
| 10 | 0 |
| 11 | 0.03 |
| 20 | 0.03 |
| 21 | 0.05 |

*Hypothetical:* last billed period ended 14 May, so the due date is 15 May; billed on 8 June, 24 days after: 0.05.
